description: Overhealing raises the target's Max HP by 10% for 2 turns.
Invigoration can trigger 1 more time.
If the ally is at full HP when Invigoration ends, they regenerate 8 Energy.
Every heal from the Skill grants the target +10% DMG for 2 turns (stacks 3).
Bailu can revive allies 1 more time per battle.
After an ally with Invigoration is hit, heals them by `multiplier` x Bailu's Max HP + `flat` (up to `triggers` times).
The Ultimate deals extra DMG to the primary target equal to 150% of the HP-loss tally.
When HP drops to 50% or lower, Max HP +20% (stacks up to 2).
Charge max becomes 4; the Talent's Follow-Up ATK deals extra DMG equal to 50% of Max HP.
Tracks HP Blade lost this battle (capped at `cap` x Max HP); the Ultimate adds `primary` / `adjacent` x tally to its DMG, then resets the tally.
After the Skill target acts, its SPD +30% for 1 turn.
After another ally's Basic ATK on a Wind-weak enemy, Bronya launches a Follow-Up ATK (80% of her Basic ATK DMG), once per turn.
The Skill's DMG Boost lasts 1 extra turn.
Using the Skill does not remove Marks of Counter.
After other allies are attacked, Svarog has a 50% fixed chance to Counter and mark the attacker. The Ultimate grants 1 extra Enhanced Counter.

While Promise, Not Command is active, Svarog Counters whenever any ally is attacked (up to `counters` times), with the DMG multiplier increased by `counterBonus`; enemies adjacent to the target take 50% of the DMG.
Reduces the Talent's cooldown by 1 turn.
The Skill's Slow reduces SPD by an extra 8%.
If the target is Slowed, the Ultimate DMG multiplier increases by `bonus`.
On a killing blow, deals Fire DMG equal to `hpRatio` x the Spider's Max HP and `toughness` Toughness Reduction to adjacent units.
Nullifies all DMG except DoT until the unit is attacked.
Uses Soulrend Coldstream on a single target, with a high chance to Freeze it.
Locks on to a target; some of Cocolia's abilities are cast one more time on it until the Lance is Weakness Broken or defeated.
The unit is defeated after the attack.
When Unyielding Will triggers, Energy is restored to 100%.
The Skill's base chance to Freeze +35%.
After an enemy Frozen by the Skill is unfrozen, its SPD -20% for 1 turn.
When the Talent triggers, Gepard immediately takes action and restores an extra 50% Max HP.
When her Skill Weakness Breaks an enemy, Himeko gains 1 extra Charge.
The Ultimate deals 2 extra instances of Fire DMG (40% of the original DMG) to random enemies.
Lightning-Lord's adjacent DMG multiplier increases by 25% of the primary multiplier.
After Lightning-Lord acts, Jing Yuan's Basic ATK, Skill and Ultimate DMG +20% for 2 turns.
Jing Yuan regenerates 2 Energy per Lightning-Lord hit.
Each Lightning-Lord hit makes the target Vulnerable (+12% DMG taken, stacks 3) until the end of its turn.
Enemies adjacent to each Lightning-Lord hit take `adjacentRatio` of that hit's DMG.
The Ultimate detonates all DoTs on the targets, not just Shock.
Base chance to Shock from the Ultimate, Technique and Talent Follow-Up ATK +30%.
When an enemy takes DMG from Shock applied by Kafka, she regenerates 2 Energy.
Shock from the Ultimate, Technique and Talent has its DMG multiplier +156% and lasts 1 extra turn.
The Skill Point refund triggers once every 2 uses of the Ultimate.
After the wearer uses the Skill, the next ally to act (not the wearer) deals `allDmg` more DMG for `duration` turn.
The status is consumed by the owner's next Follow-Up ATK.
The status is removed after the owner attacks.
Records Outgoing Healing; when an ally attacks, a random hit enemy takes Additional DMG (wearer's Type) equal to `ratio` of the recorded value, once per turn.
When the wearer's memosprite uses an ability on an ally, all allies deal `allDmg` more DMG for `duration` turns.
The Skill's Shield lasts 1 extra turn.
The Ultimate's base chance to Freeze +15%.
Each enemy Frozen by the Ultimate regenerates 6 Energy for March 7th.
The Talent's Counter can trigger 1 more time per turn and deals extra DMG equal to 30% of March 7th's DEF.
Allies with the Skill's Shield restore 4% Max HP + 106 at the start of each turn.
Each instance of DMG dealt by the ally with Mem's Support also deals True DMG equal to `trueDmg` of the original DMG.
The Skill's continuous healing lasts 1 extra turn.
The Ultimate grants allies at 30% HP or lower continuous healing (6% of Natasha's Max HP + 160) for 1 turn.
Natasha's Basic ATK deals extra Physical DMG equal to 40% of her Max HP.
After the Skill dispels a buff, the next attack deals 20% more DMG.
Dispelling a buff with the Skill grants +10% SPD for 2 turns.
For every 10% Break Effect above 120%, the Skill's DMG bonus increases by 6% (max 36%).
While the Ultimate's Zone is active, allies' DMG ignores 20% DEF.
The Zone lasts 1 extra turn; the Talent's Break DMG multiplier +200%.

Thanatoplum Rebloom: when the enemy would recover from Weakness Break, the Break is extended and its action is delayed by `delayRatio` x Ruan Mei's Break Effect + `delayBase`; can't be re-applied until the enemy recovers.
The Skill's SPD Boost can stack up to 2 times.
After the Ultimate, the target gets Butterfly Flurry for 1 turn: whenever it is attacked it takes Quantum Additional DMG equal to 15% of Seele's Ultimate DMG.
Enemies defeated during the extra turn granted by Resurgence do not grant another extra turn.
Bug durations are extended by 1 turn.
Weaknesses implanted by the Skill last 1 extra turn.
If the target has 3 or more debuffs when the Skill is used, the Skill reduces All-Type RES by an extra 3%.
After the Ultimate, regenerates 7 Energy per debuff on the target (max 5 times).
After the Ultimate, deals Quantum Additional DMG equal to 20% ATK per debuff on the target (max 5 times).
Benediction's ATK bonus is capped at `atkCap` x Tingyun's current ATK; only the most recent Skill target keeps Benediction.
After using their Ultimate, the ally with Benediction gains +20% SPD for 1 turn.
The ally with Benediction regenerates 5 Energy after defeating an enemy (once per turn).
Benediction's DMG multiplier increases by 20%.
The Ultimate regenerates 10 more Energy for the target.
When Tingyun attacks an enemy, the ally with Benediction deals Lightning Additional DMG equal to `ratio` x that ally's ATK to it.
When Mem uses "Baddies! Trouble!", it gains 5% Charge.
Mem's Support True DMG multiplier +2% per 10 Max Energy above 100 on the target (max +20%).
Allies with Mem's Support gain +10% CRIT Rate, and the Support also applies to their memosprite/memomaster.
When other memosprites act, the Trailblazer regenerates 8 Energy (once per turn).
Allies with 0 Max Energy also grant Mem 3% Charge when using abilities; their Mem's Support multiplier +6%.
For every `energyPerCharge` Energy regenerated by all allies, Mem gains 1% Charge.
While the Trailblazer has Epic and Mem is on the field, the Basic ATK becomes "Together, We Script Tomorrow!".
If Mem is already on the field, the Skill restores Mem's HP by `hpRatio` of Mem's Max HP.
After the Ultimate, the next 2 Basic ATKs / Skills deal extra Additional DMG (50% of the Basic ATK / 80% of the Skill multiplier).
The Skill's base chance to Slow +35%.
The Skill hits 1 extra time on a random enemy.
